metadata.description: Hacktron Claude Code skills for security research, finding triage, and offensive/defensive workflows.

plugins.name: finding-triage
plugins.description: Interactively validate and triage Hacktron findings against source and an optional live deployment, then fix + commit confirmed issues or set their state in Hacktron.

plugins.name: patch-diff-analyzer
plugins.description: Reverse-engineer compiled binaries (JARs, DLLs) to decompile, diff, and analyze security patches.

plugins.name: hol-guard
plugins.description: Protect supported local AI coding harnesses with HOL Guard before mutation-bearing tool work using Guard-owned setup, verification, approvals, and audit evidence.
